quirks.slider_note: 3.0.4 slider commit is per-widget unreliable, always verify via snapshot: COMMIT OK = Exercise-Treadmill Speed (value = raw_pos x 0.5 MPH, raw>100 accepted), Lifestyle/Environment Wind (value = raw_pos MPH) and Ambient Temperature (value = raw_pos - 30 degF, so 100 degF needs raw pos 130; the nominal 0-100 range only covers -30..70 degF), DietGoalH2O Rate (0..2 L/Day), Lifestyle/Air Supply Gas Tanks sliders - O2Valve(%) pos 0-100 linear and COValve(PPM) repeatlist (pos 20 = 2000 PPM) both committed 3/3 attempts in the 2026-11-05 CO trial. SILENTLY IGNORES most positions = Lifestyle/Exercise/Treadmill Grade (only raw 0 -> 0% and 50 -> 15% committed in 10 attempts; two-step zero-then-target does not help) - set Grade via model XML <parm> when a specific value is needed. Hemorrhage rate slider (earlier batches) does not commit either. Pericardial maplist sliders DO commit through SB_THUMBPOSITION for every index (verified 2026-11-05 on Trauma/Pericardium/Pericardial Hemorrhage and Intervention/Pericardial Drain): Rate = None/Mild/Moderate/Severe/Extreme -> Conductance 0.00/0.01/0.02/0.04/0.10 and Drain Rate = None/Slow/Moderate/Fast -> Conductance 0.0/0.01/0.1/1.0; index 0 needs SB_THUMBPOSITION too, because this build ignores SB_LINELEFT on maplist sliders (see the slider pos-0 fix in bridge.set_slider).
quirks.epo_note: EPO stays at its initial value on this build (known engine limitation); Hormones/EPO pools are frozen, so EPO-driven erythropoiesis acceleration is N/A. The separate [EPO]Delay.Effect structure only follows the frozen EPOPool.Log10Conc (settles ~0.975), so recovery after restoring secretion runs at ~0.975 x Base.
quirks.model_noise_note: Random terms: repeated runs agree exactly at restart, then diverge within ~2.75% on noise-sensitive rates. Two identical protocol runs from a fresh process start reproduced month-1/month-2 anemia values bit-for-bit in field trial batch 3.
quirks.exercise_exhaustion: Exercise-Control 'Wrapup' stops the subject automatically (Request->0) when SkeletalMuscle-Ph.Ph <= Exercise-Motivation.Motivation (6.65), SkeletalMuscle/RespiratoryMuscle Function.Failed, or Brain-Function Comatose/Impaired. Duration/distance: Exercise-Treadmill.ElapsedTime (Min) / Distance(Miles).
quirks.viscosity_clamp_flaky: The Body Fluids/Blood/Viscosity Clamp radio sometimes gets reverted by the engine at the next Go run after being pressed while idle (observed once). Re-press and verify Viscosity.Clamp via snapshot before starting long runs.
quirks.ics_dialog: File>Save/Load Initial Conditions opens the Vista IFileDialog (title '另存为'/'打开'): filename Edit id 1001, Save/Open button id 1, Cancel id 2; the address bar remembers the last-used directory (the MCP OUTDIR after any hummod_snapshot). hummod_save_ics / hummod_load_ics (added 2026-11, branch field/hummod-anemia) drive it with an explicit path.
quirks.status_bar_progress: While solving, the status bar shows 'Solving ...' then '... Done'; on this build the Stop menu item becomes ENABLED during the run (contrary to older notes). hummod_busy may report busy=false mid-run because the UI thread stays responsive - trust the status text.
quirks.ecg_no_modal: 3.0.4 does NOT raise the ECG state-change MessageBox ('The ECG shows V-Fib! Continue?') that 1.6.1 does - VFib induction/conversion needs no hummod_dismiss_modal; the ECG state is visible as text on Diagnosis/Chart ('ECG = V-Fib' / 'ECG = Flat').
quirks.vfib_physiology: VFib onset zeroes Heart-Rate.Rate and CardiacOutput.Flow instantly while SANode-Rate.Rate races to 195 (sympathetic surge); MAP decays to a ~22 mmHg residual with SBP=DBP; RespiratoryCenter-Output.Rate hits 0 within 1 min; Brain-Flow/Function 0 by 1 min; LeftHeart-Function.Effect decays ~0.43/min at first (1.09 -> 0.43 in 2 min), slower later. Chart page shows '- Your patient is not responding. -'.
quirks.co_air_supply: CO poisoning experiments (manual 4.3.10) are fully drivable on 3.0.4: Lifestyle/Air Supply hub page hosts Pressure Chamber + Gas Tanks + Equivalent Altitude + Inspired Air groupboxes on ONE page ('Gas Tanks' is a groupbox caption, NOT a menu node - hummod_navigate('Lifestyle/Air Supply/Gas Tanks') fails). Gas Tanks sliders DO commit (CO PPM pos 20 -> 2000 PPM; O2 pos 100 -> 100%), radio ordinals by ctrl id: 0/1 = GasTanks Switch Off/On, 2/3 = PressureChamber Off/On; slider ordinals 0=O2Valve(%), 1=CO2Valve(%), 2=H2OValve(%), 3=COValve(PPM). CO PPM slider is a nonlinear repeatlist: pos 0-9 -> 0-90 step10, pos 10-18 -> 100-900 step100, pos 19-27 -> 1000-9000 step1000. O2/N2 valves auto-renormalize via model onjustchanged (N2 slider commented out of the page). Ambient-air branch reports humidified O2(%)=21x(1-RH) ~20.83 vs tank dry-gas 20.96 - caliber differs by 0.13 pt. %COHgb is directly exportable as HgbConc.CarboxyPercent (no panel screenshot needed, unlike QCP). Key vars: CO.Mass (mg, init 4.9), CO.pCO, Lung_CO.Mass, HgbConc.CarboxyPercent, O2Artys.[O2], PO2Artys.Pressure/Sat(%), O2Veins.[O2], PO2Veins.Pressure/Sat(%). Model parms: CO.HaldaneFactor 230, Lung_CO.CO_O2Ratio 0.81, CO.EndogenousProduction 0.007 mg/min. 2000 PPM x 3 h reached COHb 47.4% with NO death/modals (GCS 13, Brain-Function 0.47 at 180 min) - QCP 2005 was unstable at 57.3% @180 min; clearance t_half: air 218 min (manual ~200), 100% O2 45 min (manual ~100, HumMod clears faster), O2 acceleration ~4.8x (QCP ~5.1x).
quirks.pericardium_304: Manual 4.3.9 (pericardial haemorrhage) is drivable on 3.0.4 but the pericardium model was REWRITTEN since 1.6.1, and the rewrite changes the physiology. 1.6.1: Pericardium-TMP.Pressure is an algebraic conditional, Stiffness is a fixed parm 0.015, and Pericardium.TotalVol uses the STATIC ventricle volumes (RightVentricle.Vol / LeftVentricle.Vol). 3.0.4: Pressure is a stabledelay (K=1.0, DxMax=0.1, errorlim 0.01) tracking Pressure-SteadyState, Stiffness is a var initialised from Sizing-Pericardium (0.008, i.e. HALF as stiff) with InitialV0 = Volume - LOG(2)/Stiffness, and TotalVol uses the LIVE diastolic volumes (RightHeartPumping-Diastole.EDV / LeftHeartPumping-Diastole.EDV). Consequences: (a) the restraining pressure now falls when the ventricles empty, so tamponade is self-limiting and the patient survives much longer than on 1.6.1 (measured: Extreme bleed-out alive at 60 min with MAP 45 mmHg, GCS 15, vs 1.6.1 cardiac arrest at 30-50 min); (b) EDV-dependent TotalVol + the lagged pressure form a fast positive feedback loop, and the solver can break down: with a Fast drain switched on at 30 min (ventricles still large) 1 of 2 identical replays stalled at X=30 and took a catastrophic step (RVEDV 66 -> 163 mL, TMP pressure 5 -> 21 mmHg) -> Heart-VFib.Is_Fibrillating = 1 -> cardiac arrest -> degenerate state (pH runs to 12+, Heart-Rate 195, CO 0). The same protocol replayed identically did NOT collapse, so this is a numerical instability, not a reproducible physiological outcome. Working rule: after switching the drain on, watch Pericardium-TMP.Pressure / RightHeartPumping-Diastole.EDV; if the solve stalls (status bar stuck on 'Solving', model clock frozen), press Stop and restart the arm.
quirks.pericardial_switch_is_cosmetic: Pericardium-Hemorrhage.Switch and Pericardium-Drain.Switch are plain model parameters that do NOT enter the flow equations (BloodFlow = PressureGradient x Conductance). Turning the radio Off does not stop the bleeding and turning it On does not start the drain - the SLIDER (Conductance) is what does it. Verified on 3.0.4: hemorrhage radio Off + Conductance 0.1 keeps bleeding at ~9.3 mL/min; drainage with radio Off and Conductance 1.0 still drains (switch stays 1.0 when read back after the radio click). Same structure as 1.6.1.

Trauma/Ventricular Fibrillation.0: Shock Now (defibrillate, 100 J = 0.8 x LeftHeart-Function.Effect). Works clicked while the simulation is RUNNING and while IDLE (2026-11-05 vfib trial: an idle click on the displayed page executed ShockNow synchronously - TotalShocks incremented and Probability/NewHeartbeat refreshed at unchanged X; supersedes the older 'idle clicks are ignored' note). TotalShocks incremented 5/5 times in that trial. Success = Heart-VFib.Is_Fibrillating flips to 0 (verify via snapshot). Sustainability rule (Heart-VFib.DES TestStart): after a converted beat the wrapup re-fibrillates immediately when LeftHeart-Function.Effect < 0.30, so shocks landed below that threshold convert electrically but always re-fib (observed at Effect 0.282/0.245); 0.325 held. Unsustainably-fibrillating heart degenerates VFib -> ECG Flat/asystole within ~5 min, and shocks on asystole do nothing. P = Effect x 0.8; Joules_Probability curve caps at 100 J so raising Joules does not raise P. Advance sim time (e.g. Go 10 Sec) between retries to draw a fresh System.Random - same-step outcomes in identical restart runs matched (fail/fail), then diverged (success vs fail) as model noise decoupled the draws.

Intervention/Defibrillator.0: Shock Now - same model action as the '!' trigger on Trauma/Ventricular Fibrillation; page also carries the Heart-Defibrillator.Joules slider (slider commit on 3.0.4 unverified).
